_comment: Written by the Security Review persona. The pre-tag CI job reads this to decide whether a release is covered by a current audit. Do not hand-edit.
open_findings: LOW #125: the client-side admin gate is a UX gate; the server-side boundary is now cited from Zendesk's 'Allowed for: Admins' documentation, but TSANet has still not probed an agent-role session. Documented-but-unverified, not closed.
MEDIUM #96: durable audit trail — direction set (B+C), documentation deliverable sequenced after #101
LOW #98: note attribution heuristic remains open pending Connect-API-Code#131
notes: Delta review of v1.0.50 against 1ec74d4 (v1.0.49). This release exists to fix the four findings that review produced.

CLOSED BY THIS RELEASE: #122 (SDK pinned to an exact version with SRI + crossorigin on all three pages, hash verified against the CDN this session), #123 (audit globs zaf-build/assets/**/*.html with an empty-glob FAIL guard; proven by committing the guard before the fix and observing the FAIL flip), #124 (validate + escape + JSON.parse before upload).

#125 is NOT closed. Citing vendor documentation converts an unverified assumption into a documented unverified assumption — a severity downgrade, not a closure. Docs on all three surfaces state plainly that TSANet has not tested an agent-role session.

FOUND AND FIXED DURING THIS REVIEW, pre-tag: substitute() was not single-pass, so a later substitution re-scanned text an earlier one had written. field_id_token=1234567891 shipped field_id_action's value; tsanet_connection_name=YOUR_TSANET_API_EMAIL shipped the engineer email. Both passed validation, left no placeholder, and parsed, so all three #124 layers missed them. Fixed in #127 (single-pass field replacement; connection substitution moved last). Not filed as an issue because it never shipped.

ALSO FOUND PRE-MERGE by QA on #126: the connection-name replacement used a replacement STRING, so `$` was expanded (my$$conn -> my$conn, valid JSON, past all three layers). Fixed with a function replacement.

Verification method note: an early harness replicated substitute() by hand and, after the fix, still reported the bug present because the replica had not changed. All later harnesses evaluate the ACTUAL source text out of deploy.js. Any future test of this file should do the same.

Cat 7: the three invalid-value messages name the SETTING KEY and never the offending value, so a hostile value cannot reach the DOM by the error path. The single innerHTML sink still escapes both interpolations.

Verified this session that the SDK check parses the tag out of the shipped HTML (src + integrity from the tag, crossorigin required, exact-version required) rather than comparing against a hardcoded constant, and that the CDN fetch uses the URL taken from that tag.

NOT verified: ZIS rejecting an agent-role session (#125); whether Zendesk audit-logs ZIS registry writes; that private apps do not auto-update, which is what the v1.0.49 'exposure believed nil' assessment rests on.
Remaining mechanical WARN is the known v1-endpoint sunset 2027-01-01 (#101).

accepted_issues records which open security issues this review knowingly ships with, so the release gate stops flagging on the standing backlog (#128). Accepted here: #96 (durable audit trail, long-horizon architecture), #119 (move off password auth, enhancement), #98 (low-priority, non-blocking anyway), #125 (boundary is vendor-documented but unprobed by TSANet), #128 (a defect in the gate itself, not in the shipped artifact). Acceptance is per-review and expires with it: source drift invalidates coverage, so the next review must re-accept explicitly rather than inheriting this list.
